customers.evidence: Focus on the user and all else will follow.

employees.evidence: We put great stock in our employees

dei.evidence: people from diverse backgrounds with creative approaches to work, play and life

community.evidence: to help people access and use even more of the ever-expanding information in their lives

shareholders.evidence: You can make money without doing evil.

integrity.evidence: Our users trust our objectivity and no short-term gain could ever justify breaching that trust.

innovation.evidence: Through innovation and iteration, we aim to take things that work well and improve upon them in unexpected ways

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice throughout, mixing hedges ('we hope', 'we believe') with absolute claims ('never'). Users come first via the headline principle 'Focus on the user'; employees and business appear later. Framing is a dated founder-era credo inviting accountability ('you can hold us to that'). Revenue passages are defensive, stressing trust and unmanipulated results.
